messages:
oncall-bot: P1 page triggered — inference cluster (us-west-2) returning 502/timeout for ~18% of requests in the last 5m. Paging oncall: @Alex G. Incident channel created.

Alex G: I'm on it, grabbing logs and checking autoscaler. Can someone confirm customer impact (percent of customer requests vs internal tests)?

Maria S: Rough numbers — for hosted inference traffic: ~18% error rate, severity varies by route. Affected models: rw-large-v1 and rw-compat-small. Rolling deploy earlier today might be related.

Priya K: Heads up — CS getting inbound messages. Customers seeing generation failures and increased latency. A few high-traffic customers in EU reported failures. Need a concise status page + email ASAP.

Alex G: Quick mitigation plan: 1) scale up fallback pool 2) route new requests to rw-compat-small-only variant while we investigate kernel/quant path. Doing scale now.

Sam T: Drafting public-facing language. Two asks: short status page update, and a tweet thread (if necessary). Drafts below — please edit.

Sam T: Status page draft (short):
```
We are investigating increased errors and timeouts for inference requests in the us-west-2 region. Some models may return 502 or time out. Our engineering team is actively mitigating and requests may be routed to compatible model variants to reduce errors. Updates will follow within 30 minutes.
```

Sam T: Customer email (concise) draft:
```
Subject: Incident: Impact to inference requests (us-west-2)

Hi —
We’re currently investigating an issue affecting inference requests in the us-west-2 region that may cause errors or increased latency. Our engineers are actively working on mitigation, and we may route requests to compatible model variants to restore service quickly. We’ll provide updates within 30 minutes.
— Redwood Inference Ops
```

Sam T: Tweet thread draft (for public):
"We’re investigating an issue impacting inference requests in us-west-2 causing some timeouts/errors. Our engineers are working on mitigation and some requests may be routed to alternative model variants to restore service. Updates to follow."

Jordan (Legal): Don’t speculate on root cause in public messaging. Keep to impact, mitigation, and ETA. Avoid mentioning deploys or internal systems.

Kim (Press Liaison): Agreed with Legal. Also recommend delaying any tweet until status page and customer email are posted — we want the canonical source to be the status page. If we go public on social, link the status page.

Priya K: Customer ops: For customers on dedicated/dedicated-private please include: "If you’re on Dedicated, contact your SE for an update" — we'll send targeted messages after status page goes live.

Alex G: Update: scaled fallback pool, routing policy applied. Error rate down to ~6% over last 3m. Continuing deeper rollback/inspection.

Sam T: Revised status page draft (aligns with Legal):
```
Update 1 — 15:12 UTC: We are investigating elevated error rates and timeouts for inference requests originating from or routed through the us-west-2 region. We’ve applied routing changes to reduce customer impact and are continuing mitigation work. Next update by 15:42 UTC or sooner.
```

Alex G: +1, accurate. Please add note: "Customers on Dedicated may see targeted communications."

Sam T: Adding that now. Final status page content:
```
Update 1 — 15:12 UTC: We are investigating elevated error rates and timeouts for inference requests in the us-west-2 region. Routing changes have been applied to reduce customer impact; affected requests may be served by compatible model variants. Customers on Dedicated receive targeted notifications from their SEs. We will provide another update by 15:42 UTC or sooner.
```

StatusPage Bot: Incident update posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-180123 — public: true

Priya K: Email to customers scheduled. Template will include link to status page and a line for Dedicated customers to contact their SE.

CommOps Bot: Draft tweet queued for approval. Use /approve to post. Draft: "Investigating elevated errors/timeouts for inference in us-west-2. Routing changes applied to reduce impact. See status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-180123 for updates."

Kim (Press Liaison): Please hold on the tweet for Legal sign-off. Also create a short blogpost draft only if incident extends past 4 hours.

Jordan (Legal): Approved public language as-is. Do NOT mention deploys. 

Alex G: Handing over to night oncall @Maria S at 15:30 UTC for monitoring and follow-ups. I'll post follow-up once root cause identified.

Maria S: Acknowledged, taking lead. Will monitor metrics and coordinate with infra if we see degradation.

Sam T: CommOps: proceeding to post status page link + customer email. Waiting on @Jordan (Legal) confirm to release tweet.

Jordan (Legal): Confirmed. You can post the tweet now.

CommOps Bot: Tweet posted: https://twitter.com/redwood_infer/status/1370000000000000000 (auto).

Priya K: Noting: CS triage board updated, customers with SLA exposure flagged for 1:1 outreach.

Alex G: Final technical note before handoff: logs show elevated KV cache eviction rate coincident with the window. Investigating kernel/quant paths as follow-up. No change to public messaging.

Maria S: Thanks all — monitoring and will escalate if error rate trends up. I'll update channel if status page needs a new message.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-180123 status changed to "Monitoring" at 15:35 UTC — paging suspended.

Kim (Press Liaison): Great coordination — thank you. After this settles, let's do a quick 15-min sync tomorrow to align on post-incident comms (tweet thread vs blog vs postmortem link). :thumbsup:
